brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: Base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full holds bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-compartment), piece:1,0,0;full holds bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3-compartment) — both removable drop-in bins
drawer:0#0,-1#cut on half-s base piece:0,-1,0;half-s with drawer frame notch:0#0,1#notch1 providing structure

No handle part present. Handle requires a cover on its face (find_sockets handle offers s121/s122 only when cover present). Covers were removed to allow bins and not re-added with handle before finish.

finish.summary: Portable organizer has 2-cell base with two removable compartment bins and one drawer, but lacks carry handle - unmet due to cover/handle not installed in remaining turns. Mesh clear, only LOOSE_BODY warning.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
